name: Sea Turtles Program
summary: Grants for sea turtle recovery work, mainly nesting beach habitat restoration and protection in Florida, the US Virgin Islands and Puerto Rico, bycatch reduction, stranding response and rehabilitation capacity, and population-scale networks. The 1:1 match applies to beach and bycatch work only.

geography.label: Mostly U.S. beaches and coastal waters; other Western Hemisphere projects a lower priority

eligibility.rule: Not a U.S. federal agency or unincorporated individual
Stranding or rehab projects: follow network procedures, meet USFWS captive care rules, have capacity
No NFWF funds for ongoing legal compliance, including permit conditions, mitigation and settlements

documents: Site map, if proposing a habitat restoration project
Design schematic, if proposing a habitat restoration project

deadline.text: Pre-Proposal Due Date August 19, 2026, 11:59 pm EST

status.quote: Sea Turtles 2027 Request For Proposals - CLOSED

deadline.quote: Pre-Proposal Due Date August 19, 2026, 11:59 pm EST Invitations for Full Proposals Sent September 2026

applicant_types.quote: Eligible applicants include: Non-profit 501(c) organizations State government agencies Local governments Municipal governments Tribal Governments and Organizations Educational institutions International organizations For-profit organizations

geography.quote: Most funded projects will take place along U.S. state or territorial beaches, facilities, or coastal waters. Other projects targeting sea turtle conservation in the Western Hemisphere will be considered but as a lower priority for funding.

access.quote: All application materials must be submitted online through National Fish and Wildlife Foundation's Easygrants system.

window.quote: Full Proposal Due Date October 27, 2026, 11:59 pm EST

amount.quote: Most awards under this program will fall in the range of $50,000 to $400,000

co_finance_required.quote: A minimum of a 1:1 non-Federal match of cash and/or in-kind services is required for beach and bycatch work and is accepted for stranding/rehabilitation projects but not required.

effort.quote: Pre-Proposal Due Date August 19, 2026, 11:59 pm EST
Invitations for Full Proposals Sent September 2026 Full Proposal Due Date October 27, 2026, 11:59 pm EST

eligibility.quote: Ineligible applicants include: U.S. Federal government agencies Unincorporated individuals

will follow procedures defined by regional stranding networks (including data collection and reporting), will meet the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service's Standard Conditions for Care and Maintenance of Captive Sea Turtles, and will have established infrastructure and capacity to deal with stranding and/or rehabilitation.
NFWF funds may not be used to support ongoing efforts to comply with legal requirements, including permit conditions, mitigation and settlement agreements.

co_finance.quote: A minimum of a 1:1 non-Federal match of cash and/or in-kind services is required for beach and bycatch work and is accepted for stranding/rehabilitation projects but not required.

after_award.quote: the Sea Turtles Program has a list of metrics in Easygrants for grantees to choose from for reporting.

documents.quote: The pre-proposal narrative template may be downloaded from Easygrants at any time and completed at your leisure. It must be uploaded back into your Easygrants application before your application may be submitted.
If you are proposing a habitat restoration project, please provide a site map and a design schematic.
